episodes.name: S1 - Alternative Title Track
episodes.overview: A completely different intro sequence that was created during early production—not used in the final show. More stylized and abstract, sometimes referred to by fans as the “blue anatomy” version. Features different music and a more dramatic tone. Sometimes called "Grey's Anatomy Avant-Garde Intro" on fan forums.

episodes.name: S1 - Avant-garde Trailer
episodes.overview:
Experimental Trailer:

A stylized promotional video created before the show aired. Very different from the final tone—dark, edgy, almost indie-film-like. Uses haunting music and dramatic editing, highlighting the emotional stakes and interpersonal tension rather than the medical drama. Included on some international Season 1 DVDs or as an Easter egg.

episodes.name: S5 - 100th Episode (Tales From the OR)

episodes.name: S6 - Chandra Wilson (Anatomy of a Talent)
episodes.overview: This bonus feature focuses on the career and performance of Chandra Wilson (Dr. Miranda Bailey), highlighting her journey from theater to television and her evolution on Grey’s Anatomy. Cast, crew, and Shonda Rhimes praise her emotional range, precision, and leadership both on and off screen, offering a heartfelt tribute to her impact on the show.

episodes.name: S6 - Seattle Grace: On Call (Part 1) - I Want A Paternity Test
episodes.overview: Megan awkwardly deals with the uncertainty of whether the father of her baby is her husband Steve or ex Pierce while the other interns flirt and banter in Joe’s bar.

episodes.name: S6 - Seattle Grace: On Call (Part 2) - Why is Megan Crying?
episodes.overview: A teary Megan opens up to Pierce about her fears regarding her pregnancy while Steve and the others continue joking around in the background .

episodes.name: S6 - Seattle Grace: On Call (Part 3) - Have a Good One!
episodes.overview: Steve and Megan perform a duet as the hospital house band, while Pierce confronts his unresolved feelings and Ryan humorously flirts with Reed.

episodes.name: S6 - Seattle Grace: On Call (Part 4) - I Guess That's a No!
episodes.overview: Megan hesitates to open the paternity test results, leading to tension between Steve and Pierce as they wait anxiously in Joe’s bar

episodes.name: S6 - Seattle Grace: On Call (Part 5) - Way to Make a Scene!
episodes.overview: A physical fight breaks out between Steve and Pierce over Megan’s pregnancy, culminating in Megan finally revealing the paternity result.

episodes.name: S6 - Seattle Grace: On Call (Part 6) - We Need to Disband!
episodes.overview: Following the paternity reveal, Megan ends her marriage to Steve, Pierce steps up, and an impromptu karaoke performance by Owen lightens the mood.

episodes.name: S7 - The Music Event (Behind the Scenes)
episodes.overview: This featurette dives into the making of Season 7, Episode 18: “Song Beneath the Song”, the show's first and only full musical episode. Cast and crew discuss vocal training, choreography, and how the emotionally charged episode pushed them out of their comfort zones.

episodes.name: S7 - In Stitches (Outtakes)
episodes.overview: Bloopers from Season 7.

episodes.name: S7 - Seattle Grace: Message of Hope (Part 1) - No Comment
episodes.overview: Dr. Webber and the staff brainstorm ideas for a hospital promo video to rebuild Seattle Grace’s image following the shooting incident.

episodes.name: S7 - Seattle Grace: Message of Hope (Part 2) - Take One
episodes.overview: While Dr. Avery and April film a segment promoting the hospital’s recovery efforts, Webber grapples with presenting the right tone of hope and strength.

episodes.name: S7 - Seattle Grace: Message of Hope (Part 3) - The Face
episodes.overview: Owen, Avery, and other staff shoot interviews discussing safety and community, as Webber oversees the message they hope will restore trust.

episodes.name: S7 - Seattle Grace: Message of Hope (Part 4) - Nerves
episodes.overview: The team contends with the tension of what to highlight in the campaign, balancing optimism with truth as they film around the hospital.

episodes.name: S7 - Seattle Grace: Message of Hope (Part 5) - Award-Winning
episodes.overview: A surprise setback during filming forces Webber to adjust the campaign's narrative, adding authenticity to their promotional reel.

episodes.name: S7 - Seattle Grace: Message of Hope (Part 6) - The Sizzle
episodes.overview: The series wraps as Seattle Grace premieres the finished video, and the staff reflect on how the process has helped them heal and move forward.

episodes.name: S7 - Making of "Message of Hope"
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes of the 6 part web series.

episodes.name: S8 - A Journey Home with Kevin McKidd
episodes.overview: This emotional featurette centers on the character arc of Owen Hunt, played by Kevin McKidd, focusing on his personal and professional struggles throughout Season 8 — especially in relation to his military past, failing marriage with Cristina, and leadership at Seattle Grace. Cast and crew reflect on Owen’s inner conflicts, showing how his trauma and decisions shape not only his journey but also those around him.

episodes.name: S9 - Happy Trails with James Pickens Jr.
episodes.overview: This featurette offers an in-depth and enjoyable glimpse into the life of James Pickens Jr., the actor behind Dr. Richard Webber. It delves into his personal interests, particularly his passion for the cowboy lifestyle, and how he channels that enthusiasm into his charitable endeavors.

episodes.name: S9 - The Long Road Home with Jessica Capshaw
episodes.overview: This featurette follows Jessica Capshaw as she discusses portraying Dr. Arizona Robbins’ emotional and physical journey after her traumatic leg amputation. It includes behind-the-scenes insights into the challenges of bringing this powerful storyline to life and its impact on Arizona’s character development.

episodes.name: S11 - Spotlight: Caterina Scorsone
episodes.overview: Get to know long-time ShondaLand actress Caterina Scorsone. From her days on "Private Practice" to joining the cast of "Grey's Anatomy," Caterina has fabulously portrayed Dr. Amelia Shepherd, little sister of Dr. Derek Shepherd. Find out how she came to the role, what it is like to be a series regular on two of Shonda's shows, and what a typical day on set is like for her.
